human_decisions.text: apply to go into the universities
human_decisions.evidence: 核验/正文清理/2015-双模型.json，实际窗口[907, 929]。印本+Whisper为apply to go into the universities，Parakeet为apply to going to the universities；保留有源正文并记录语流重切分差异，使用整个同段短语真ASR索引，不以语法猜单词时刻。
human_decisions.source_sentence_en: The number from the state schools, who are going to leading universities, has increased over the years, but there is still an issue about ensuring the pupils from our state schools apply to go into the universities, and if you look at the Oxford figures, for example, you see that the percentage of students applying to Oxford from the state schools is about 1%, whereas from the private schools it’s over 4.5%, so that, you know, that’s the problem, it’s expectations in the state system that have been driven down by this Government over the years.

human_decisions.text: the government say in the future
human_decisions.evidence: 核验/正文清理/2015-双模型.json，实际窗口[1154, 1163]。印本+Whisper为the government say（英式集合名词），Parakeet为government says；主ASR合为governments。保留有源真实口语候选，整个短语绑定同一音段并明列s连读分歧，不强改书面主谓。
human_decisions.source_sentence_en: ... well, the government say in the future eighty-five pence in the pound will go to the schools.
